# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- User prefers EcoSort to adopt a WinUI shell similar to WinUI Gallery/AI Dev Gallery: sidebar-based multi-page navigation (likely NavigationView or equivalent), with a rich home dashboard containing mixed components like recent classification carousel and sustainability tips, and dedicated pages for classification, education, and future location-based resources.
- Reference up-to-date Microsoft Learn documentation and use the latest Windows ML APIs (Microsoft.Windows.AI.MachineLearning / Windows App SDK) for live inference implementations.
